authorizationPolicy.description: A simulated eSign scenario may only be applied while the acting session holds the payment:approve capability; scenarios never carry raw PII, only sanitized reason codes and safe copy.

latencyPolicy.description: Simulated eSign latency is bounded and clamped by the mock envelope layer; min_latency_ms and max_latency_ms are hints for deterministic demo behavior.

outcomes.label: Signed
outcomes.description: The signer completed the eSign ceremony and the payment is approved for release.

outcomes.label: Declined
outcomes.description: The signer actively declined to sign the payment.

outcomes.label: Expired
outcomes.description: The eSign request lapsed before the signer completed the ceremony.

outcomes.label: Unavailable
outcomes.description: The eSign provider is temporarily unavailable and could not accept the request.

outcomes.label: Transient Error
outcomes.description: A transient error interrupted the eSign ceremony; the request can be retried.

next_step.title: Signature confirmed
next_step.body: The signer completed the eSign ceremony. This payment is now approved and ready for release.

next_step.title: Signature declined
next_step.body: The signer declined to sign this payment. Review the payment details and, if appropriate, submit a new approval request.

next_step.title: Signature request expired
next_step.body: The eSign request lapsed before it was completed. You can resend a fresh signature request to the signer.

next_step.title: eSign provider unavailable
next_step.body: The eSign provider is temporarily unavailable. Wait a moment and try requesting the signature again.

next_step.title: Something went wrong
next_step.body: A transient error interrupted the signature ceremony. No changes were made — please retry the request.
